{{SameName|Present3|[[Present3 (Cold Ambush)|Cold Ambush]] • '''Krampus Frosthold'''}} {{EventEnded|date = 31st of January 2024|event = [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Present3 |image1 = Present3Image.png |mode_appearance = [[Krampus' Revenge Event|Krampus' Revenge]] |first_wave_appearance = 18 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]100 |shield_hp = [[File:ShieldHealth.png|20px|Shield Health]]80 |defense = {{Defense}}35% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2.4) |cash = {{Money|1,000}} on death |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Holiday Gift}}''' - Upon death, spawns three [[Present2 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present2s]]. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|If I float up one more time, I'm going to get sick!
Looks like we're in this mysterious force's lair..
Who ever is behind this is going on the naughty list!|[[Santa]] dialogue on Wave 18 ([[Krampus Frosthold]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Present3''' was an enemy that first appeared on Wave 18 in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a rather low amount of health, a slightly slow speed and 35% defense. However, when it died, it would spawn three [[Present2 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present2s]], which combined with the large hordes of '''Present3s''' that spawn, could make it a very dangerous enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Present3''' was a humanoid present. The wrapping paper was a checker pattern of squares that were colored between tones of red and white. There was a white ribbon going across its head and torso, as well as a big white bow on its chest. It was slightly bigger than the average enemy. ==Strategy== *Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] are recommended to deal with the hordes of '''Present3s''' and their spawns. **Splash damage towers can especially be useful, as most of them can deal full damage to defense enemies. **A lot of area of effect towers have defense dropping capabilities, making them to decrease the '''Present3's''' defense and allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. Such towers include the [[Pyromancer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Jester]]. *Multiple high DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Accelerator]] can deal with this quite well. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting the firerate and range of these towers respectively. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Christmas 2023 Trailer|'''Present3''' in the game trailer. }} ==Update History== *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Present3''' added. *'''31 January 2024''' - [[v1.12.0]]c **'''Present3''' removed. {{KrampusFrosthold|[[Cookie Guard (Krampus Frosthold)|Cookie Guard]] & [[Gatekeeper (Krampus Frosthold)|Gatekeeper]]|Wave 17|Present3, [[Papa Bread (Krampus Frosthold)|Papa Bread]] & [[Builder Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Builder Elf]]|Wave 18|[[Evil Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Evil Elf]], [[Sleigh (Krampus Frosthold)|Sleigh]], [[Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold)|Toy Soldier]] & [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Present3}}
